faq_q1: How does SSLM guarantee tenant data isolation and branding?
faq_a1: The platform enforces a true multi-tenant architecture isolated at both the subdomain and database schema layers. Every safety firm operates on their own branded portal with distinct styling and strictly partitioned data.
faq_q2: Is the platform compliant with Saudi Civil Defense regulations?
faq_a2: Yes, SSLM is fully aligned with Saudi Building Code (SBC 801) fire protection standards, providing end-to-end digital governance across Alarm, Suppression, and Smoke Control systems.
faq_q3: How does ZATCA 15% VAT invoicing work?
faq_a3: The platform automatically partitions taxable and exempt line items, calculates the 15% VAT, and produces ZATCA-compliant electronic tax invoices and quotations.
faq_q4: What are the requirements to start using the platform?
faq_a4: Getting started is instant. Simply register your company, configure your subdomain and brand colors, and invite your team to begin handling licensing requests immediately.
